tool_version: pefile 2024.8.26, Capstone 5.0.6, Ghidra 12.2 PUBLIC; s5 Zig 0.13.0 Windows AMD64 COFF
scope: AMD64 PE unwind and code export anchors; recursive direct call targets; bounded direct-flow blocks; named switch and leaf models; s5 complete single-instruction import thunks and original resource payloads
limitations: Unrecovered bodies, indirect targets, other jump tables, ABI prototypes and unvisited ranges require review. Chained unwind fragments are grouped by root, without asserting each range is a separate function.
